The change is the working-tree diff of four files against the tag: git diff base/M1STATUS-20261122-02 -- app/public (css/site.css, how.html, js/pages/demo.js, shared/i18n/texts.js); also read handoffs/M1STATUS-20261122-02/step-02-frontend-dev.json (the developer report: the placements, margin-top 2px on .now .stat is in the design CSS table but not in the look: judge it). result.summary: REVIEWER, WF-02 step 4, REQ-113. PASS: no Critical, High or Medium finding; four Low findings, none blocking. Q1 cause: the change adds a static block and moves text; nothing swallows an error, no check is bypassed; the failure paths keep the block (measured: result request answered 500 -> block, panel and failure message all stand). Q2 agreement: the four files equal design 4.1 to 4.5 (13 keys added, 2 values changed, idea_panel_fine removed, 167 -> 179 keys, 45 order_ keys); all 30 ru and en values equal docs/requirements.yaml verbatim; order inside #stage-1 is h2, p.stat-line, note, paragraph; h3#now-title labels section.info.now; criteria 1 to 10 and 12 each lead to code. Honesty: nothing promises a date, a contact or an invitation; the block holds no a, button, input, select, textarea or form (0 in 90 result loads). Q3 extra work: git diff of base tag lists only the four write-set files in app/ and nothing in tools/ or .github/; the only extra item is margin-top 2px (L1 below). Q4 erosion: grep of the diff for skip, todo, eslint-disable, innerHTML, style=, http://, decisions, handoff, orch, REQ-digit finds nothing; no test touched. Q5 idiom: el()/textContent only, key names written in full in NOW_ROWS, frozen constant, same style as the neighbours. Old tests: read every assertion that touches the four files (landing.test.js readResult/LD-3/LD-6/LD-9/LD-1/LD-2, stage.test.js, public-pages PP-1..5, public-build PB-1/PB-2/PB-6, forbidden-words, texts TX-1..5, e2e-kit, page-checks, browser.js shownTextFindings): none pins the changed values or counts children of .res / how.html sections, so none turns red from the product change; the replacement table of the design (section 10) is right. Files are LF (0 CR bytes), prettier-clean. For TEST-DESIGNER: LD-6 must assert the mark-to-title geometry and the first-screen top (measured 557 px at 390x844) because no existing oracle sees max-width 640 or the .stat.on fill; the dead .fine selector (L2) is a free negative oracle for nothing, do not add a test for it.

findings.place: app/public/css/site.css:1470-1474 (.now .stat { margin-top: 2px }) and 1483-1486 (the phone rule margin-top: 0)
findings.what: The design CSS table (4.5) has margin-top: 2px on .now .stat, the look 7.22 does not: it says the mark is order 2, align-self flex-start so that its top is the title's top. Measured in real Chrome at 1470 in ru, en, kk and both themes: mark top minus title top is exactly 2.0 px in all 18 wide loads (mark box 24 px, title line 23.2 px), so the mark's centre sits 2.4 px below the title's centre instead of level with it. Without the 2 px the boxes are 24 and 23.2 high and start together. The design departs from its own measure here.
findings.fix: Delete margin-top: 2px from .now .stat and, with it, the now redundant margin-top: 0 in the max-width 479px rule. No test pins it; layoutFindings gives 0 either way. Fold into the next CODE-FIXER pass if one is opened, otherwise DESIGN-QA-VALIDATOR judges it against 7.22.

findings.what: The class fine is now used by no element in app/public (grep -w fine over html and js, outside texts.js, finds nothing; at the base its only user was the removed p.fine of demo.js). The selector .fine in the shared rule is dead. The look and the requirement still name .fine as the 14 px grey class that the notes must not use, so removing it needs a note in the look.
findings.fix: Either reduce the rule to .meta { ... } (index.html still uses .meta) and note it in the look, or keep it and record it as vocabulary. Not blocking.

findings.what: The comment of the result grid still says div.wrap.res > div.r-sum, section.idea, div.r-ans ...; the wrapper now holds div.r-side > (section.info.now, section.idea). The comment of .receipt says div.rc-acc (span.lbl + div.prog); it now also holds a p. Stale comments (AP-005).
findings.fix: Write div.r-side (section.info.now + section.idea) in the first comment and div.rc-acc (span.lbl + div.prog + p) in the second.

findings.what: The rewrapped comment has one line of about 120 characters next to two short ones. Prettier does not reflow comments, so this is formatting only.
findings.fix: Rewrap the three lines to the width of the neighbouring comments.
